summary: Iteration 9 retest of DutyConnect Phase A+B fixes (frontend only, viewport 390x844, Free user delivered+t1@resend.dev). All four in-scope checks PASS: (1) Shifts → List → History shows the 3-days-ago shift ('AB Recent3d', Fri 9 Oct, Standard shift, 4h, £80.00) and HIDES the 20-days-ago shift ('AB Old20d' not present). (2) history-older-prompt (testID present) is rendered with title '1 older shift is safely stored' and body text 'Free shows the last 7 days. View every record by exporting a CSV (Account → Export my data), or upgrade to browse them here.' — the previous 'last 30 days' / olderHidden=0 bug is fixed (FREE_HISTORY_DAYS is now 7 at /app/frontend/src/billing/entitlement.tsx:85 and olderHidden uses allShifts at /app/frontend/src/components/shift-list-view.tsx:48). (3) Account → Personal details (account-edit-profile-row) value reads 'Custodial & justice' and 'Prison Officer' no longer appears anywhere on the Account screen — the backend startup migration at /app/backend/server.py:880-883 successfully updated the legacy user's professional_category. (4) Home 'This week' card renders on Free (shows 0 completed, £0.00 estimated gross, 3 booked · £240.00 projected from the seeded future shifts) and the Earnings tab renders with the '12 Oct – 18 Oct 2026' header, Estimated gross £0.00 card and Export report button. No React Native red screens. Only carryover console warnings: 'shadow* style props are deprecated' (pre-existing). One 403 on a resource load (likely a non-critical static/manifest fetch — did not block the UI). Seed data was fully cleaned up after the test.
